name: dns-doctor
description: Scan, fix, verify and monitor a domain's DNS: email authentication (SPF, DMARC, DKIM) with DMARC monitoring and evidence-based enforcement guidance, plus multi-region propagation, SPF include supply-chain audits, MX, DNS health, blacklists and domain/SSL expiry. Returns deterministic verdicts and copy-paste fix records generated by a validating engine, never a guessed record.

interface.shortDescription: DMARC monitoring plus SPF, DKIM and DMARC diagnostics for any domain. Scan email authentication, find SPF lookup-limit problems, check DKIM and DMARC, generate validated DMARC records, monitor DMARC RUA reports and new senders, and move from p=none to quarantine on a scan's evidence and to reject on report evidence. You publish every record yourself.
interface.longDescription: DMARC monitoring plus SPF, DKIM and DMARC diagnostics for any domain. Scan email authentication, find SPF lookup-limit problems, check DKIM and DMARC, generate validated DMARC records, monitor DMARC RUA reports, new senders and website uptime (five locations on four continents), and move from p=none to quarantine on a scan's evidence and to reject on report evidence. You publish every record yourself. Fix records are generated deterministically and RFC-validated, never guessed by AI; SPF is diagnosed, never rewritten. The tools: scan a domain (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, DNS health, blacklists, domain and TLS expiry), read the stored report, build a validated DMARC upgrade or a DMARC record from scratch, validate a pasted DMARC record, count SPF lookups, audit SPF includes, check a DKIM selector, check a record on the domain's own nameservers, check global propagation from six vantage points, check reverse DNS, look up a domain's registration, check which lookalike domains of it resolve, check whether it is set up to show its logo in inboxes (BIMI), test a real email sent to a single-use address and read how it authenticated, parse a DMARC aggregate report, build the hardening pack for a non-sending domain, hand the owner a monitoring sign-up link, for signed-in operators read the monitoring alert log, the enforcement-readiness verdict and the watched lookalike domains, and for a linked account add a domain, check its verification and read its records. The assistant never signs the user in, never emails on their behalf, and never applies a DNS change: it explains the findings and presents each record for the human to publish.
defaultPrompt: Mail from my domain lands in spam. Check its SPF, DKIM and DMARC.
Give me an address for a test email, then check its authentication and delivery risks.
I changed a DNS record. Check whether it is correct and has propagated.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.20.0. New tool check_domain_names: when choosing a domain name, check up to 20 candidates in one call and see which ones the registry already holds (registered, not registered, or unknown when the registry did not answer). Premium status and price are not checked. Existing tool names and inputs are unchanged.
